name: wall handstand push-up negative
description: The lowering half of a wall handstand push-up, done slowly. It builds the strength to press the full rep.
instructions: Kick up into a handstand with your heels on the wall and a cushion under your head.
Brace your core and keep your elbows angled slightly forward.
Bend your arms and lower your head slowly toward the floor.
Take three to five seconds to reach the bottom.
Touch your head lightly, then bring your feet down and reset.
